description: Checks a product feed or catalog export for Google Merchant Center, Shopify or Meta (Facebook/Instagram) before upload. Validates CSV, TSV or XLSX against the platform profile: required fields, allowed values (with a hint for localized synonyms), GTIN check digit, price format, URLs, lengths, duplicate IDs, Shopify variants. Every issue names row, column, rule code and a fix hint; nothing is changed. The feed can be passed as upload, URL or CSV text.

file.description: The feed. A file uploaded in ChatGPT (object with download_url and file_id).
file.title: File

file_base64.description: The feed. File content as Base64 (standard alphabet). Max 20 MiB decoded.
file_base64.title: File Base64

file_path.description: Local file path; only allowed when the server runs locally over stdio.
file_path.title: File Path

file_text.description: The feed. The table as CSV or TSV text, header row first (e.g. 'SKU;Price;Currency\nA1;12.50;EUR').
file_text.title: File Text

file_url.description: The feed. Public URL of the file (http/https). Google Drive, Google Sheets and Dropbox share links are converted to direct downloads. Max 20 MiB.
file_url.title: File Url

filename.description: Original filename with extension (e.g. prices.xlsx); used to detect the format.
filename.title: Filename

profile.description: Target platform: google_merchant, shopify_products_csv or meta_catalog.
profile.title: Profile

name: merchant_validate
title: Validate a product feed
